Neutron sources and materials testing under fusion-relevant conditions have advanced nuclear fuel qualification, radiography, and radiation therapy planning. These spinoffs show that iritic as a marker of interdisciplinary fusion work reflects tangible gains in health, manufacturing, and sustainable global infrastructure.
